Welcome to my homepage.

I am a research assistant at the Mathematics Institute of the University of Cologne since September 2026. I work under the supervision of Prof. George Marinescu and Prof. Alexander Drewitz in the framework of the DFG funded project Random Polynomials and Random Kähler Geometry.

I received my PhD from Université Paris Cité in 2026 under the supervision of Prof. Xiaonan Ma and Prof. George Marinescu.
